job: Show rows that are mostly text with one action each.
purpose: Rows that share one grid, so metadata and trailing actions align down the list however long the titles are. Each row has a lead (avatar, tile or icon), a title and description, a meta and a trail. A list reads lighter than a table. Rows can be links or buttons.
useWhen: Members, integrations or files with a name, a line of detail and one action.
An inbox where unread rows carry a dot.
A card of rows divided by hairlines.
People choose one item from a short list of rich rows: role="listbox" with role="option" rows.

avoidWhen.when: Numbers that line up in columns and sort.
A set of cards for browsing.
The row is a setting with a control.

states.name: unread
states.how: data-unread on a row; a dot before the title

states.name: interactive
states.how: data-interactive on the list; every row is a link or button with hover and focus

states.name: selected
states.how: aria-current="true" on the row whose record is open; aria-selected="true" on a role="option" row

variants.useWhen: Hairlines between rows without a frame.
A framed list on a card surface.
Every row is a link or button.
Meta in mono, as for IDs and times.
A round lead mark for people.
Tint the lead mark in the accent colour.

parts.role: A right-hand value, such as a role.
An arrow showing the row opens.
A stretched link over the row.

keyboard.keys: Arrow Up, Arrow Down, Home, End
keyboard.does: In a role="listbox" list: moves the selection, which follows focus.
